headline: Lykos Isle, DeadLands Flare as Fishermans Row Cools
war_summary: New despatches show Lykos Isle and DeadLands as the freshest fronts. Lykos Isle logged two strategic-base actions in the past two hours and four in six, latest at 22:25; DeadLands, quiet at the last edition, stirred again with two flips in six hours and seven in a day. Fishermans Row, the previous edition's crucible, has gone silent in the latest two hours after a twenty-action day; Linn Mercy and Stlican Shelf likewise show no flips since evening, though day totals remain high at thirty-two and six. Godcrofts saw three actions in six hours, its latest at 20:15. Weathered Expanse again exacts a fearful toll - more than twenty-two thousand Colonial and nineteen thousand Warden casualties in a day - with no strategic base changing hands. Stonecradle, Tempest Island, KingsCage, Endless Shore, and Oarbreaker remain still after earlier action. Clahstra's casualty rate climbs sharply, but no base flips have been reported there.
